evidence: Saturation is the Benson and Krause fit (Garcia & Gordon 1992) with Benson & Krause's pressure factor, extended from its stated 1.1 atm to the Moon's 1.2, for the air's 17.46% O2 and the held fresh seas' salinity. The lakes are a one-dimensional model (biosphere/ecology/lake.py) checked against analytic diffusion, convective and wind deepening, reaeration and conduction-limited ice, with heat and oxygen conserved to round-off, forced from the GCM's 3-day means at the T21 cells holding three crater lakes: the design case (the lock) and the test with the longwave refitted by height and ice optics (the hot world), years 10-19, the resort interpolated between them by the ground's temperature, which mixes two physics. The surface exchange is paired as PlaSim pairs it, at the lowest level's height with its wind, potential temperature and humidity, as corrected after the independent review of 18 October and its re-check. Below the mixed layer the dissipation is the share of the wind's energy flux at 10 m that Earth's lakes pass to their stratified water (Wuest, Piepke & Van Senden 2000), spread over the water's mass there and bracketed by the share's measured range, with the flux on Wuest & Lorke's lake drag as Simstrat pairs it (the drag the measured share was taken against is open; the lake model's own stress at lunar gravity gives about half to four fifths of that flux at these light winds); the fixed dissipation and Yeates & Imberger's Lake-number diffusivity are sensitivity rows, and the cap on the diffusivity holds no interface back. Each deep lake settles at the analysis step after its coarse spin-up. Oxygen demand is bounded scenarios from published lakes on Earth (design values where labelled), fixed by the supply of organic matter; the warm kinetics are a transient beside the bounds. The lunar gravity enters every buoyancy term. The runs are calculations on one GCM's climate at T21; no lunar lake has been measured.
reading_rule: Oxygen in g/m3 (mg/L); quantiles are lists of the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles. saturation.targets gives each target's seas at their median and band temperatures at 1.2 atm, and three_day_means the distribution over the GCM's water cells at each cell's own pressure, the resort interpolated by the share of the way as climate_targets does. runs.deep and runs.shallow are keyed target/band, under the wind's deep mixing at its central share of P10 (0.3%); runs.deep_eta_low and deep_eta_high hold the deep lakes at its bracket (0.2% and 0.4%); runs.deep_lake_number holds the 0-15 lakes under Yeates & Imberger's diffusivity from the Lake number, and runs.deep_fixed under the first round's fixed dissipation (central 1e-10 and high 1e-9 W/kg, capped at 1e-4 m2/s), keyed target/band/dissipation; runs.wind_old_cap the wind's mixing under the old cap of 1e-4 m2/s, and runs.wind_cap_raised under a cap ten times the wind's, 1 m2/s, the check that its cap holds nothing back. Each case's deep_mixing gives the treatment, the dissipation the wind gave (W/kg) and the shares of the interfaces below the mixed layer at the cap, held back by it (the cap slower than a step's own mixing) and unstable. Each case's oxygen is keyed trophic/transfer/kinetics: transfer 'renewal' (Tedford et al. 2014, central) or 'cole_caraco'; kinetics 'supply' (demand fixed by the trophic state's supply, the bounds) or 'warm' (the deep water's and floor's demand with 0.62 eV from the source hypolimnia's 6 C, production and the euphotic water's labile pool held: a transient no settling supply sustains, kept out of the bounds), and trophic/renewal/supply/labile_2d and labile_7d carry the labile pool's brackets about its central 4 days. The variant runs keep the central renewal/supply columns. mixing.complete_overturns counts the lunar cycles, sunrise to sunrise at the site, in which the mixed layer reached the bottom layer, and deepest_m each cycle's deepest mixing; deepest_tenth is the deepest tenth of the lake's volume; overturns reads the oxygen after each complete overturn; lake_number is the Lake number from the column every three days with z_T at the strongest stratification below 10 m (month, the lunar month's thermocline) and below 2 m (day, the day's warm layer). nights run from sunset to sunrise and days from sunrise to sunset; surface_minimum is each night's lowest surface oxygen and surface_minimum_share_of_the_night when it falls. settling.spin_up records each spin-up pass in coarse steps and, under at_the_analysis_step, each pass at the analysis step after them (the deep water's temperature, oxygen, age and solute, and whether the pass overturned). runs.sensitivity varies the solutes and the trophic state the physics follows at the 0-15 lake; runs.deepest takes that lake to the 1,925 m deepest point that half the lake area exceeds, oxygenated at the start as if just overturned, and runs the record, and runs.deepest_long (with its eta bracket) first passes over the record until it settles (up to 30 passes, then up to 10 at the analysis step); runs.resort_from_hot builds the resort from the hot world's weather. checks.slab compares a 50-m mixed slab with the GCM's own slab ocean, paired at the lowest level and at 10 m, each with the free convection at lunar gravity and at Earth's; checks.resolution drives the lakes from the design case's 6.4-hour means of its years 20-21 at a half-hour step (six_hourly), from their 3-day means at that step (three_day) and at the main runs' steps, two hours for the deep lake and one for the shallows (three_day_main_step). answers holds the central runs and the eta bracket's.

setting.pairing: the lowest level's wind and height (PlaSim's), with its potential temperature and humidity carried to the lake
